title: 2D vs 3D Sound & Spatial Settings
description: Control Spatial Blend, distance rolloff, panning, and spread to create realistic soundscapes.

slides.title: 2D vs 3D Sound 🌐
slides.content:
# Flat vs Positional

- **2D Sound** – plays at constant volume regardless of listener's position. Good for UI sounds, narration, background music.
- **3D Sound** – volume and panning change based on distance and direction from the Audio Listener. Perfect for footsteps, gunshots, environmental effects.

The **Spatial Blend** slider controls the mix: 0 = fully 2D, 1 = fully 3D. Values in between blend both.

quizData.question: What Spatial Blend value gives a purely 3D sound?

slides.title: 3D Sound Settings 🔉
slides.content:
# Distance and Rolloff

When Spatial Blend is > 0, you'll see the **3D Sound Settings** in the Audio Source. The most important is the **Volume Rolloff** curve:

- **Logarithmic Rolloff** – realistic, volume drops quickly then fades.
- **Linear Rolloff** – volume decreases uniformly.
- **Custom Rolloff** – draw your own curve.

Adjust the **Min Distance** (where sound is at full volume) and **Max Distance** (where volume reaches zero). Beyond max distance, the sound is silent.

**Spread** controls how the sound is panned (0 = point source, 180 = fills all speakers). Use for ambient vs. precise sound.

quizData.question: At what distance does a 3D sound become silent?
quizData.explanation: Beyond Max Distance, the volume reaches 0.

slides.title: Doppler & Audio Filters 🌪️
slides.content:
# Advanced Effects

- **Doppler Level** – simulates the pitch change when the sound source or listener moves relative to each other (like a passing ambulance). Set > 0 to enable.
- **Audio Filters** (Low Pass, High Pass, Echo, etc.) can be added as components to a GameObject containing an Audio Source. They process the audio signal.
- **Reverb Zones** – create areas where sounds have reverb (echo). Place them in scenes like caves.

These add realism but can be CPU‑intensive.

slides.title: Setting Up a 3D Gunshot
slides.content:
Example setup: 
- Import gunshot sound.
- Attach Audio Source to a gun GameObject.
- Set Spatial Blend = 1 (3D).
- Set Rolloff Mode = Logarithmic, Min Distance = 1, Max Distance = 30.
- Play via script when shooting.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Visualize Rolloff

In the Scene view, you can see the min/max distance spheres as wireframes when the Audio Source is selected. Tweak distances visually.
